title: Handle symbolic links in landing fixture snapshots on macOS
outcome: Handle symbolic links in landing fixture snapshots on macOS
acceptance: The landing fixture snapshot records symbolic links without following their targets, including dangling links, while preserving byte checks for ordinary files and recursive directory comparison.
Regression coverage proves a dangling link no longer causes snapshot bytes NotFound and a changed link target is detected; the original inherited repository-routing assertions remain intact.

completion.summary: Corrected landing fixture snapshots to classify entries without following symbolic links and preserve their exact raw targets. Ordinary file byte checks and recursive directory comparison remain; original inherited Git-routing assertions pass. Added dangling/cyclic directory-link, equal-content retarget, raw target-spelling and Unix file-link regressions. Final Windows full gate all9 stages passed on frozen input e89098b9; both required independent Codex/Kimi reviews clean, prior Medium fixed and reviewed again; independent acceptance 2/2 fresh. New release all4 live stores ready, backup/install verified before push. Native macOS and cfg(unix) execution unverified. Test-only change, no production/durable/schema/projection change; running sessions need no restart.
